Join millions of players in the best free online Bingo game in the world!

🌟 What is Bingo Blitz?
Bingo Blitz is a free online Bingo game where you travel the world with Blitzy the cat, play themed Bingo rooms, collect souvenirs, and win daily rewards — all while connecting with a global community of millions of players.

🤩 Why players love Bingo Blitz:
• Multiple card play: Play up to four Bingo cards at once and boost your chances of winning!
• Power-Ups: Get faster Bingos and win more prizes with game-changing Power-Ups!
• Collect souvenirs: Take Pics with Blitzy at every destination you visit together.
• Cook & win: Collect ingredients in Bingo rounds and cook dishes for extra rewards!
• Special Events: New limited-time events, seasonal celebrations, and exclusive prizes — every week!
• Global Bingo rooms: Play non-stop online multiplayer Bingo with players from around the world.

🎁 Free rewards — every single day:
• Free daily Credits
• Free daily wheel spins
• Daily quests with extra prizes
• Fresh new content every day
• Free Bingo games

🤗 A social game with millions of friends:
• Global community with millions of active players
• In-game chat rooms
• Exchange items with other players
• Invite friends for bonus rewards
• Share your wins on social media

🎬 Watch tips, updates, and surprises on our YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/c/BINGOBlitzTV

We would love to hear from you, wherever you are in the world! Get support: https://www.bingoblitz.com/support/

Bingo Blitz is intended for those 21 and older for amusement purposes only and does not offer 'real money' gambling, or an opportunity to win real money or real prizes based on game play. Playing or success in this game does not imply future success at 'real money' gambling.

Bingo Blitz does not require payment to download and play, but it also allows you to purchase virtual items with real money inside the game, including random items. You can disable in-app purchases in your device's settings. Bingo Blitz may also contain advertising. You may require an internet connection to play Bingo Blitz and access its social features. You can also find more information about the functionality, compatibility and interoperability of Bingo Blitz in the above description and additional app store information.

By downloading this game, you agree to future game updates as released on your app store or social network. You may choose to update this game, but if you do not update, your game experience and functionalities may be reduced.
